resolutions.researcher_notes: Egypt Oil & Gas Newspaper's Sept-2020 'Crude Oil Squad' report tables a 'Zeit Bay-Ras Shukheir' line (From: Zeit Bay (Pre-2017), To: Ras Shukheir, 40 km, 16 in, 140 mmcf/d) among Egypt's seven active Gulf of Suez/Sinai gas pipelines, confirming Status=operating as of 2020. Single source, medium tier. url_verifier's automated screen fails on this PDF's multi-column table layout (text extraction reorders adjacent-cell digits/words); hand-confirmed via `pdftotext -layout` that 'Ras Shukheir' etc. are genuinely present (standing rule 8 -- screen miss, not a verdict).

Same table lists Zeit Bay-Ras Shukheir under 'Natural Gas Infrastructure', confirming Fuel = Gas. Single source, medium tier. PDF extraction quirk hand-confirmed via pdftotext -layout (see Status unit).

A dedicated 40 km / 16-inch trunk moving gas from the Zeit Bay facility area to Ras Shukheir is long-haul transmission infrastructure, not local distribution -- PipelineType=transmission is a direct inference from the table's description, not a literal label. Single source, medium tier. PDF extraction quirk as in Status unit.

Table gives Zeit Bay-Ras Shukheir a capacity of exactly 140 mmcf/d, matching the sheet's 140.00 MMcf/d. Single source, medium tier. url_verifier's automated screen misses this due to the PDF table's column layout; hand-confirmed present via pdftotext -layout (standing rule 8).
Same table gives a length of exactly 40 km, matching the sheet's 40.00 km. Single source, medium tier. PDF table extraction quirk hand-confirmed via pdftotext -layout (see Status unit).

The pipeline originates at the 'Zeit Bay (Pre-2017)' facility per the gas-infrastructure table, and the same article separately describes 'Zeit Bay fields' as a producing Gulf-of-Suez concession (operated via Suez Oil Company, Wintershall Dea's JV with EGPC). This supports FuelSource='Zeit bay field' by inference from the pipeline's own name/origin point rather than an explicit 'fuel source' statement, so held at low tier despite being a single source that does verifiably name the field.

Table gives the route as From: Zeit Bay (Pre-2017) To: Ras Shukheir, matching EndPrefecture/District=Ras Shukheir; both points sit on the Gulf of Suez/Red Sea coast, consistent with StartState/Province=Red sea and EndState/Province=Red sea. Single source, medium tier.
